summary: Master transport economics and infrastructure planning with practical appraisal tools, forecasting methods, and investment reporting you can apply immediately.
lede: Transport economics and infrastructure planning equips professionals to assess demand, compare infrastructure options, and justify investment decisions. Designed for people working with transport networks, investment, or policy, the course covers cost-benefit analysis, demand forecasting, lifecycle costing, and valuation of congestion and other impacts. Participants also practise sensitivity analysis and prepare investment recommendations to support planning and project appraisal.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with transport networks, infrastructure investment, or policy analysis and need a more rigorous approach to appraisal and planning.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and familiarity with transport planning or infrastructure decision-making. A basic understanding of project budgets, demand data, or capital planning will help you complete the exercises more quickly.
